title: CopytradeSignalPayload
description: Parsed Discord BTO/STC/AVG line emitted by signal-source-discord and consumed by CopytradeSignalWorkflow. Carries the underlying ticker plus the (expiry, strike, right) tuple — NOT the resolved OCC option symbol. OCC resolution (e.g. 'AAPL250117C00150000') is performed downstream by ContractActivities.resolve and surfaces on OrderIntent.option_symbol / PreTradeCheckRequest.option_symbol. Reference: docs/plans/PLAN.md, oh-my-opentrade/backend/internal/domain/copytrade.go.

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. Workers reject newer-than-build inputs to force orchestrator rollback. Start at 1; bump when fields change in non-backward-compatible ways.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope key. Required on every Activity payload and workflow input.

strategy_id.description: Strategy scope key within the tenant.

message_id.description: Discord message id the line was parsed from.

author.description: Discord username that posted the line.

posted_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the message was posted on Discord (source-of-truth: sidecar from Discord DOM).

action.description: Author intent: buy-to-open, sell-to-close, or retrospective average-note.

ticker.description: Underlying equity ticker (e.g. 'AAPL'); uppercase, no exchange suffix. This is the RAW underlying — not an OCC option symbol. The full OCC symbol (e.g. 'AAPL250117C00150000') is composed downstream by ContractActivities.resolve from (ticker, expiry, strike, right) and lands on OrderIntent.option_symbol before exec.

expiry.description: Option expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) at 00:00 UTC of that calendar date.

price.description: Author's stated fill premium (per contract, dollars). 5-30s stale by the time we read it; size off fresh ask not this.

tail.description: Raw trailing text after the parsed grammar (e.g., 'half out', 'partial'). Empty string if none.

close_intent.description: Optional classifier hint for STC lines: whether the author intends a full exit or a partial. Null/absent = unclassified. Spec-only in Phase 1 (PLAN-2026-07-25-stc-intent-classifier); no consumer yet — the orchestrator STC-intent enforcement lands in a later phase, gated per-tenant.

close_confidence.description: Optional confidence score in [0,1] for close_intent. Null/absent = no score. Spec-only in Phase 1; no consumer yet.

raw_line.description: The line as parsed, for audit.
